{{Quote|Be careful, they're still making battle droids. Destroy their troop center to shut them down for good!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=RipTroopCenter.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
Betweeen [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|conflict]] for ownership of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a group of Wookiees led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] '''attacked''' a [[Trade Federation outpost]]. The attack marked the beginning of Chewbacca's campaign to remove the Federation's presence from Alaris Prime following an [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|attempt]] on the life of his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], with the outpost being chosen for the attack due to its production of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s. With the guidance of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], the Wookiees created a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (shipyard)|base]] on the opposite side of a [[Water/Legends|river]] near the outpost and began training more [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] there after identifying the outpost's location. Chewbacca led the attack with a force of eleven other Wookiees, destroying the five [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] guarding the outpost along with the [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|He has decided on a perilous course. To show our resolve by raiding a nearby Trade Federation outpost. His hope is that they'll think twice before challenging us again.|Qui-Gon Jinn, referring to Chewbacca's plan to attack the outpost|audio=OutpostBriefing.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[Time/Legends|Sometime]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] began between [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] and the corporation known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for possession of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. The [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] was [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|nearly]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], but was [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|saved]] by his [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who became the new leader of the colonists.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Wookiee_attack_base.png|thumb|left|350px|The base where Chewbacca trained troops to attack the outpost]]
With assistance from [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Chewbacca planned to intimidate the Trade Federation leadership into abandoning Alaris Prime through a demonstration of force, selecting a [[Trade Federation outpost]] where B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were produced as a target. The colonists created a new [[Unidentified Wookiee base (shipyard)|base]] near the outpost's location and, with Jinn's guidance, built a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] to train [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and a [[Mech/Legends|mech]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] to manufacture two [[HummBike]]s, a type of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]].<ref name="GB" />

Using those vehicles, Wookiee [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] found no trace of the Trade Federation outpost on the accessible stretch of land, so Jinn concluded that it was on the other side of the [[Water/Legends|river]] near the base. The Wookiees built a [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] on the riverbank and assembled an aquatic [[Transport Ship (Wookiee)|transport ship]] there to ferry the scouts over the water. Once the riders located the outpost, Chewbacca trained a group of eleven other warriors to attack the outpost.<ref name="GB" /> These included [[bowcaster trooper]]s, mounted [[dragon trooper]]s who rode [[Katarn/Legends|katarns]] and were equipped with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]], and [[Thermal detonator trooper (Wookiee)|thermal detonator troopers]], along with a [[Wookiee medical droid]].<ref name="Prima" /> Chewbacca and these Wookiees boarded [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ships, which were built at the shipyard, and crossed the river to the path to the outpost.<ref name="GB" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|They're walled in. Attack the wall to bash your way through!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees during the attack on the outpost|audio=WalledIn.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The dragon and [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] began the battle by attacking the light wall around the outpost.<ref name="Prima" /> The [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of five B1 battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] there, [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] remotely by [[GWC-04]], fired on the Wookiees with their [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]],<ref name="GB" /> and in response, they were destroyed by Chewbacca and the other [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] troopers. Once portions of the wall were broken down, the Wookiees moved into the outpost and destroyed the [[Troop/Legends|troop]] center with the flamethrowers and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], limiting the Trade Federation's production of battle droids on Alaris Prime.<ref name="Prima" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|A lesson learned in battle is sometimes the most indelible. Pray you do not have to learn too many of these.|Qui-Gon Jinn, after the battle|audio=Lessond.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Battle_droids_Alaris.jpg|thumb|right|220px|B1 battle droids and a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] on Alaris Prime after the battle]]
The Trade Federation remained on Alaris Prime despite the loss of the outpost, and after they [[Attack on Chewbacca's camp|attacked]] one of the Wookiee [[Chewbacca's camp|bases]], Chewbacca and his forces [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|destroyed]] a Trade Federation [[Trade Federation listening array|listening array]] and eventually removed the corporation from Alaris Prime entirely in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You've lost a lot of troops but don't worry, you can create more at your troop center and try again.|Qui-Gon to the player, if their forces are all killed in the battle|audio=OutpostFail.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The attack on the Trade Federation outpost was first shown in a preview published on [[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN's]] website on [[October 10]], [[2001]] for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=http://pc.ign.com/articles/135/135959p1.html|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds|date=2001-10-10|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20020222012010}}</ref> The attack was subsequently described in [[Prima Games]]' accompanying [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]],<ref name="Prima" /> published on [[November 7]], 2001,<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> before appearing in the game itself,<ref name="GB" /> which was released on [[November 11]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The attack is the main feature of the fifth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, entitled "Exploration and Transport." On the tutorial selection screen, ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' recommends the level as a starting point for players who are already familiar with real-time strategy game mechanics.<ref name="GB" />

The attack functions as an opportunity for the player to consolidate their real-time strategy skills with an easy mission where one can practice building bases and [[Army/Legends|armies]].<ref name="Prima" /> The player is able to move on if they lose a significant number of troops, but will lose the battle if Chewbacca is killed.<ref name="GB" /> Unlike most levels in the campaigns and in the standard game mode settings, the player is able to see the enemy base on the in-game maps through the unexplored black area called the fog of war. The strategy guide portrays some aspects of the battle<ref name="Prima" /> differently from the finished game,<ref name="GB" /> stating that several battle droids await the player on the path to the camp and that more droids spawn from the troop center to attack the Wookiees. The guide also recommends building an army of fifteen Wookiees for the attack,<ref name="Prima" /> whereas in the game, Jinn suggests that only twelve will be necessary.<ref name="GB" /> This article assumes the game's portrayal of events to be correct.
